task.title: Build Taiwan normalization pipeline for Shioaji, TWSE, TPEx, MOPS, and TEJ
task.summary_zh: 補齊台股 Shioaji quote 與 TWSE/TPEx/MOPS/TEJ 的 normalization pipeline，完成 symbol mapping、market segment、disclosure join。
acceptance: Taiwan symbol mapping is canonicalized across Shioaji TWSE TPEx and TEJ
market segment and exchange boundary are preserved in normalized datasets
disclosure and fundamentals joins are replay-clean and documented
task.next: Owner finalized approved Taiwan normalization pipeline task and closed it after reviewer-verified canonical market-segment normalization and replay-clean join checks.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：Taiwan normalization helpers、source-boundary README 與 replay-clean join contract 整體符合 acceptance；review 中補上顯式 market_segment（OTC／上市）會被 canonicalize 成 otc／listed 的 edge case，避免 symbol mapping helper 輸出非 canonical segment。

Focused verification 重新實跑通過：python3 -m unittest services.data-plane.tests.test_data_plane_schemas -v（47 passed）、python3 services/data-plane/smoke_test.py（47/47 passed）；另行驗證 build_tw_symbol_mapping_record 對 OTC／上市 皆輸出 canonical segment。

handoffs.message: Ready for review. Added Taiwan normalization pipeline helpers in services/data-plane/taiwan_reference.py for venue canonicalization, symbol mapping, market segment preservation, Shioaji raw/normalized dataset lineage, and Shioaji+TWSE/TPEx/MOPS/TEJ replay-clean joins. Documented the source-boundary/join contract in services/data-plane/README.md and verified with python3 -m unittest services.data-plane.tests.test_data_plane_schemas -v (47 passed) plus python3 services/data-plane/smoke_test.py (47/47 passed).
Review approved after fixing explicit market-segment canonicalization in Taiwan symbol mapping; owner can finalize to done.
